name: The Chess Club
description: Regulars at the chess club each swear by a different opening, a favourite tactic, and a prized set. Work out who plays what.
clues: Pirc goes with exactly two of Magnus, Zwischenzug, and Walnut.
Magnus does not go with Marble.
Between Boris and Garry, one goes with French and the other with Zwischenzug.
Sicilian goes with either Glass or Rosewood.
Either Magnus goes with Zugzwang or Vera goes with French.
Vera, Zugzwang, and Glass belong to different players.
Boris goes with at least one of Italian, Sicilian, or Zwischenzug.
Exactly one of these is true: Vera goes with Zugzwang; Pirc goes with Zwischenzug; Zugzwang goes with Glass.
French goes with at least one of Sacrifice or Rosewood.
